description: This file defines a React context and state management logic for an app that tracks habits and tasks. It includes reducer functions, actions, and hooks related to application state, including habits, tasks, filters, and notifications.

methods.name: pushToast
methods.description: Adds a toast notification to the application state.

methods.name: removeToast
methods.description: Removes a toast notification by ID from the application state.

methods.name: recomputeHabitStreak
methods.description: Recalculates the current and best streaks for a habit based on completed dates and today's date.

methods.name: reducer
methods.description: Handles state updates based on dispatched actions, covering habits, tasks, filters, and UI notifications.
